criterion: Labels/copy: control means what it says
description: To drop her priority edit after Theo set P0, Maya sets the form's Priority back to P2 (the draft's base). The form then shows P2 while the save keeps P0: choosing P2 is how you keep P0. Related to F-075-01.
expected: A per-field 'Use latest (P0)' / 'Keep mine (P1)' choice on the conflicting field, with the form always showing the value that will be saved.
actual: Form P2, card P0, save keeps P0
suggested_fix: Mark fields changed elsewhere inline with the newer value and per-field actions; auto-follow untouched fields.

description: After Close → project switch → return, the panel does not reopen, so the person has to remember which card held the draft. Nothing on the board marks tasks with unsaved drafts.
expected: A draft marker on the card, or a 'You have an unsaved edit on …' hint after return.
actual: Board with no panel and no draft cue
suggested_fix: Show a small 'Draft' badge on cards with stored edit drafts.

description: After the hub was stopped and restarted, Maya's header showed 'Remote presence unavailable' for the rest of the session (presence session returned 410 Gone), although sync had recovered and showed 'Saved locally · synced'.
expected: Presence re-establishes a session automatically after the hub returns.
suggested_fix: On 410 from the presence report, start a new session instead of giving up.
